welcome.title: What shall we build today?

Discuss ideas, work with files
and turn tasks into results.

welcome.tests.title: Help with tests
composer.placeholder: Describe a task or ask a question
composer.agentHint: The agent can read files and propose commands
composer.caption: Responses are generated by the selected model. Double-check important results.
composer.keyHint: Enter ↵ · Shift Enter for a new line
voice.p1: Browser dictation may send audio to an external speech recognition service. This depends on the browser and is unrelated to the local model.
voice.p2: The result appears in the input field. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
voice.unsupported: This browser does not support dictation. Open kvalah in Chrome or Edge.
voice.listening: Listening… Click the microphone to stop.
delete.title: Delete chat?
delete.note: The chat will be moved to the trash. You can restore it from Settings together with its messages and attachments.
trash.title: Trash
project.openHint: Work with an existing folder or Git repository
project.promptPath: Absolute path to the project folder
project.noPlanYet: The plan will appear once the agent starts working.
project.noSteps: The agent has not made a plan yet.
project.noChecks: Success has not been confirmed by tests or a build yet.
project.noCheckpoints: Checkpoints appear after an agent turn (Git must be installed).
project.note: This list shows changes made by file tools. PowerShell commands may change other files too: use rewind to the start of a turn for those. A launch check means the program started without crashing immediately, not that the whole UI was tested.
change.undoneToast: Change undone. Checks need to be run again.
checkpoint.rewind: Restore files to the start of this turn
checkpoint.confirm:
Restore all project files to their state before this turn?
“{label}”
Changes made after that point (including by commands) will be discarded. The current state is saved as a separate checkpoint.
files.afterReply: Attach files after the response finishes
files.max: No more than 8 files per message
files.noText: {name}: file saved, but text cannot be extracted from this format
copy.failed: The browser did not allow copying
device.checkUrl: Check the server address in Settings
approvalHint.auto: reads and project rules run automatically, everything else requires approval
agent.onTitle: Agent on. Project files are handled automatically; {mode}.
agent.offTitle: Turn on the agent to work with your computer
agent.enabled: Agent on: permissions are requested as needed.
agent.disabled: Chat mode: actions are turned off.
caption.full: Full access: commands run without approval.
caption.agent: Project folder: no extra prompts. External access and running code require approval.
caption.chat: Chat mode: answers only. Turn on “Agent” to take actions.
status.otherTab: A request is running in another tab. Wait for it to finish and reload the page.
status.analyzing: The model is analyzing the result…
status.preparing: The model is preparing a response…
done.awaiting_verification: The project has not passed verification yet
done.length: Paused: response cut off by the generation limit
error.noToken: No session key. Open kvalah from the app or via the link in the server window.
approval.accessNote: Access lasts until the current task ends; denying stops the action.
approval.shellNote: The command runs with your user permissions and can change files and settings outside the project. Folder permissions do not restrict PowerShell. Review the command before running it.
approval.commitNote: A commit will be created in the project repository.
approval.writeNote: The file will be created or replaced at the given path. A backup is kept for an existing file.
settings.title: Assistant settings
settings.workspaceNote: File operations inside the project folder run automatically. Access to other folders is requested per task. Open an existing project with the “Open folder” button above the chat. PowerShell is not confined to the project folder: this is not a sandbox.
settings.approval.auto: Auto — read-only commands and project rules need no approval
settings.approval.full: Full access — no approvals (use with care)
settings.apiKeySaved: saved — leave empty to keep it
settings.toolNote: “Auto” uses native tools when the model supports them, otherwise the <tool_call> text protocol. Text mode helps models that mix up the call format. The key is stored in the settings on this computer.
settings.filesP1: Text, code, CSV, JSON, DOCX and text-based PDFs are extracted locally. PNG, JPEG and WebP are available to vision-capable models. Scanned PDFs require OCR. XLSX and other binary formats are stored without text extraction.
settings.filesP2: Dictation depends on the browser. Chrome / Edge may use an external recognition service. For fully local input, attach a ready-made transcript.
settings.afterReply: Settings are available after the response finishes
settings.shutdownConfirm: Stop kvalah? History is kept. To start again, open START.vbs.
settings.shutdownDone: Server stopped. To start it, open START.vbs.
settings.shortcuts: Create shortcuts: desktop and Start menu
srv.noVision: This model does not support images. Choose a vision-capable model or remove the image.
srv.checkpointsUnavailable: Turn checkpoints are unavailable: {error}. Undoing individual file edits still works.
srv.contextTooSmall: Agent tools need a context of 8192 or more. Chat mode supports 4096.
srv.streamBroken: The model stream ended before the response was complete
srv.lengthRetry: The model response was cut off by the generation limit. The model will continue in smaller parts.
srv.lengthStopped: The model response was cut off by the generation limit several times. Increase the context or ask for changes in smaller parts.
srv.lengthPaused: Response cut off by the generation limit; the task is paused.
srv.toolCallMalformed: The tool call could not be parsed. Retrying with a strict format.
srv.toolCallMissing: The model did not call an available tool. Retrying with explicit tool instructions.
srv.repeatedStop: Repeated error: further identical attempts were stopped. A different approach is needed.

srv.stepLimit.one: Reached the limit of {n} step. Work is saved. You can continue from the current project; do not repeat checks that already ran.
srv.stepLimit.other: Reached the limit of {n} steps. Work is saved. You can continue from the current project; do not repeat checks that already ran.

srv.notVerified: The response is complete, but project completion is not confirmed. verify_project and finish_task are required.
srv.timeout: The model did not finish responding within 10 minutes
srv.absPathProject: Enter an absolute path to the project folder
srv.tooWide: The folder is too broad (drive root or home folder). Choose a specific project folder.
srv.sessionExpired: The session has expired. Restart kvalah or open the link from the server window.
srv.rewound: Project files restored to their state before turn “{label}”. Files changed: {n}.
srv.absWorkspace: Enter an absolute path for the workspace folder
srv.workspaceMissing: The workspace folder does not exist
srv.badUrl: The server address must start with http:// or https://
srv.stopBeforeDelete: Stop the response first, then delete the chat
srv.uploadLimit: This chat has reached its attachment limit
srv.approvalInactive: This approval is no longer active
srv.approvalOtherTask: This approval belongs to a different task
srv.consoleKeepOpen: Keep this window open. To stop: Ctrl+C.
srv.portBusy: Port in use. kvalah may already be running: {origin}
prov.ollamaTimeout: Ollama did not respond in time ({url})
prov.ollamaModels: Could not get the Ollama model list
prov.ollamaStream: The Ollama stream ended before the response was complete
prov.serverTimeout: Server {url} did not respond in time
prov.toolsRejected: The server rejected tools. Turn on the text tool protocol in Settings.
prov.serverStream: The server stream ended before the response was complete
desktop.backendStopped: The local server stopped. Restart the app. Code: {code}
desktop.backendTimeout: The server did not start within 30 seconds. Log: {path}
desktop.backendExited: The server exited during startup. Log: {path}
desktop.createShortcuts: Create desktop and Start menu shortcuts
desktop.shortcutsDetail: The trowel icon now appears on the desktop and in the Start menu.
desktop.aboutDetail:
A local assistant for open models.
The coral trowel. Chat, files and tools.
Dictation in the desktop window depends on engine support; a browser version is available in Chrome/Edge.
settings.autoUpdateNote: At startup and every 6 hours via GitHub Releases. Installs only when you click the button or quit.
devices.entryNote: Use other computers on your network: split one big model across them or run sub-tasks in parallel.
devices.title: Devices
devices.shareNote: Other kvalah apps on your local network can pair with this computer using the code below. Nothing is reachable from the internet.
devices.name: Device name
devices.shareTasksNote: Paired devices may use this computer's model ({backend}). Cloud API keys are never shared.
devices.shareRpcNote: Lends this computer's GPU and RAM to a pooled model started on another device.
devices.firewall: Your firewall may ask to allow kvalah: allow it on private networks only. Ports: {port} TCP (pairing, tasks, pool) and 47318 UDP (discovery).
devices.llamaNote: Needed for Pool memory on the host and on every worker. All devices must use the same build ({build}).
devices.llamaPath: Or the folder of your own llama.cpp build
devices.unsupported: There is no prebuilt llama.cpp for this system; set the folder of your own build.
devices.tasksNote: The agent gets two extra tools that run independent sub-tasks (code search, review, per-file jobs) in parallel on the devices below. Edits and verification stay on this computer.
devices.noneFound: No other kvalah found. Turn on “Share this device” on the other computer, or add it manually.
devices.ollamaNote: A bare Ollama must listen on the network (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0) and has no password — add it only on a network you trust. Pairing with kvalah is safer.
devices.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? It will have to be paired again.
devices.poolWarn: Pool memory splits one model across the selected devices, so models that don't fit on one computer can run. Every generated token crosses the network, so it is usually slower than a single device. Use wired Ethernet (1 Gbit/s or better); Wi-Fi works but is slow.
devices.poolNoWorkers: Pair a device, tick “Memory” for it, and turn on “Pool memory worker” on that device.
devices.poolNeedsLlama: Install llama.cpp on this computer first (tab “This device”).
dev.err.noLan: No local network connection found (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
dev.err.portBusy: Port {port} is already in use. Choose another port.
dev.err.badPort: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
dev.err.llamaMissing: llama.cpp is not installed. Download it in Settings → Devices → This device.
dev.err.llamaPath: No llama-server or ggml-rpc-server found in that folder.
dev.err.unpaired: This device no longer accepts our pairing. Remove it and pair again.
dev.err.notPrivate: Only devices on your local network can be added.
dev.err.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 10 minutes.
dev.err.modelMissing: Choose an existing GGUF model file.
dev.err.rpcNotRunning: {name}: the RPC server is not running. Turn on “Pool memory worker” on that device.
dev.err.buildMismatch: {name} uses llama.cpp {build}; all devices need the same build.
dev.warn.customBuild: {name}: own llama.cpp build — make sure every device uses the same version.
dist.retry: Device {device} failed; retrying on another one
